camel_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost CreateNetworkDomain --region cn-hangzhou --Proxies.1.Address '47.104.00.00' --Comment comment --NetworkDomainName SSH_Proxy --Proxies.1.NodeType Master --Proxies.1.Port 22 --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-lbj3bw4ma02' --Proxies.1.ProxyType SSHProxy --Proxies.1.Password 'UWdi000000Ng==' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --NetworkDomainType Proxy --Proxies.1.User root --method POST --force
description_en: If you want to perform O\\\\\\&M operations on assets that reside in different networks or assets that cannot communicate with the virtual private cloud (VPC) of your bastion host in a centralized manner, we recommend that you use the network domain feature of Bastionhost. You can configure a proxy server for these assets, create a network domain for a bastion host, and then connect the network domain to the proxy server. This way, you can perform O\\\\\\&M operations on the assets by using the bastion host
description_zh: 如果您想统一运维分布在不同网络环境中或与堡垒机所在专有网络（VPC）网络不互通的资产，推荐使用堡垒机的网络域功能。您可以为这些资产配置一台代理服务器，然后在堡垒机中创建网络域并添加代理服务器，将资产加入该网络域后即可通过堡垒机运维资产
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost create-network-domain --instance-id bastionhost-cn-lbj3bw4ma02 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --network-domain-name SSH_Proxy --network-domain-type Proxy --comment comment --proxies User=root Address=47.104.00.00 NodeType=Master Port=22 ProxyType=SSHProxy Password=UWdi000000Ng== --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateNetworkDomain

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host for which you want to create a network domain.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
指定要创建网络域的堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host for which you want to create a network domain.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要创建网络域的堡垒机的地域ID。
区域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the network domain that you want to create. The name can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 指定要创建的网络域名称，最大128字符
parameters.name: network_domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The connection mode of the network domain to be created. Valid values:

Direct

Proxy
parameters.help_zh:
指定要创建的网络域类型。取值：
Direct：直连，表示堡垒机直接和资产网络连通，不经过中间代理服务器。
Proxy：代理，资产所在网络与堡垒机网络不通的情况下，可以通过代理服务器转发网络请求，实现对不同网络环境下的资产进行运维
parameters.name: network_domain_type

parameters.help_en: The remarks of the network domain. The remarks can be up to 500 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 网络域的备注。最多500字符
parameters.name: comment

fields.help_en: The username of the proxy server
fields.name: user

fields.help_en: The IP address of the proxy server
fields.name: address

fields.help_en:
The proxy type. Valid values:

SSHProxy

HTTPProxy

Socks5Proxy
fields.help_zh:
代理方式。取值：
SSHProxy：SSH代理
HTTPProxy：HTTP代理
Socks5Proxy：Socks代理
fields.name: proxy_type

fields.help_en:
The node type of the proxy server. Valid values:

Master: primary proxy server.

Slave: secondary proxy server
fields.help_zh:
代理服务器节点。取值：

Master：主代理服务器
Slave：备代理服务器
fields.name: node_type

fields.help_en: The Base64-encoded password of the proxy server
fields.help_zh: Base64处理后的代理服务器账户的密码
fields.name: password

fields.help_en: The port of the proxy server
fields.name: port

parameters.help_en: The information about the proxy servers
parameters.name: proxies
